I was around when reddit first started out, and It was a great at that point. Smaller community but it was more self-regulated and users held each other to high standards. Forced people to think about what they type or submit without the need for outside influences (generally). It was quite nice. Comments were generally informative and factual.

I hope this place can evolve to something like that. Put more responsibility on the user to self moderate. A lot of people are putting blame on "SJW" ( It was two years before I figure out what that meant) which I am not detracting from their influence, but I think it was a site wide problem. Others many not have gone to the same length, but they displayed a lot of the same characteristics. Quality did not matter, but rather who's opinion or comment resonated most with the majority of the users. I even found myself behaving in the same manner, which also was one of the reasons I am hoping to switch.

Ultimately though I think it will be a great challenge. Like I mentioned I was there in the beginning, but the internet was different then as well. It wasn't as popular as it is today, so it might be a pipe dream to have anything resembling what was responsible for reddits popularity (as well as other sites as well). I will try my best to be a decent member of this community and keep my non-sense to a minimum.
